sections.name: File setup

sections.name: bounds-aware scene atmosphere
sections.title: Atmosphere and framing checks
sections.what: Checks that close-up fog keeps its original value, that distant overviews stay legible at several sizes, and that a wide flat box has all its corners inside the camera view at several screen shapes.
sections.why: Keeps the overview readable on large sites and stops the framing from cutting off parts of the site.
sections.watch_out: The legibility check uses a formula that approximates visibility, so it checks intent rather than exact rendering.

sections.name: opening view for spread-out sites
sections.title: Checks for the opening view
sections.what: Two checks on the opening camera framing. A compact site must be framed whole. A very long line into a substation yard must open on the busy yard end, keep the nearest structure in view, and stay narrower than 260 metres.
sections.why: Locks in the opening-view behaviour so a change cannot zoom out to kilometres or cut off the busy area.
sections.watch_out: The 260 metre limit and the 90 metre margin are tuned numbers, so a sound layout change can break this test.

summary: Tests that the scene fog stays readable and that the camera framing keeps a large site fully in view.
purpose: Protects the camera and fog rules so spread-out sites remain legible at several screen shapes.
why: Likely reason: large sites need fog and camera distance rules that are easy to break with a small change.
how: Checks the close-up fog value, then checks that the fog keeps distant overviews legible at several sizes. It then places the camera for a wide flat box at several screen shapes and checks each corner projects inside the view.
inputs: Fixed sizes, screen shapes and camera settings written into the tests.
outputs: Pass or fail results from the Vitest test runner.
risks: The fog check uses a formula that approximates visibility, so it checks intent rather than exact rendering. The third group of checks in the framing module is not included here.
debug: Run this file alone. If a corner test fails, check the camera offset rule for the aspect ratio. If a fog test fails, check the density rule against the radius.
